Introduction

Shin Eui Jin (신의진; also stylized as ShinEuiJin and Shin Uijin) is a South Korean singer under IX Entertainment. She made her solo debut on December 31, 2021, with her first digital single "Broom". In 2021, she was a contestant on the KBS survival show "The Legend, The New Singer". In 2022, she was a contestant on the Mnet survival show "Artistock Game".
